description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ReviewServiceException' within the OrangeHRM Performance module, providing specific error handling related to performance reviews.

classes.name: ReviewServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in Exception, providing static methods to generate specific error instances related to performance review functionalities.

methods.name: activateWithoutJobTitle
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that a review cannot be activated for employees lacking a Job Title with KPI.

methods.name: activateWithoutKPI
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that a review cannot be activated without KPIs.

methods.name: pastEmployeeForReviewer
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that a past employee cannot be added as a reviewer.

methods.name: invalidSupervisor
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that the selected supervisor for reviewer is invalid.
